blockRowHeight.description:
Row height for annotation and segment rows, in px. The minimap and
sequence rows size themselves from `density`, and the features rows have a
prop of their own.

data.description: The window to draw. Null renders the empty state.

density.description:
Comfortable is the standalone view; compact is the in-card variant used by
a comparison row, which tightens every row and drops the labels and
captions.

disableNavigation.description:
Disable wheel-zoom and drag-pan. The track still reports selection, and the
keyboard controls still work — this only turns off pointer navigation, for
a card that should not capture scroll.

featureRowHeight.description:
Height of one feature's bars in the features row, in px, not counting the
space above them that the feature's name occupies.

maxFeatureRows.description:
How many traces the features row draws, `pinned` first and then `features`
in the payload's own rank order.

A cap rather than "all of them" because the row's height is unbounded in
the data: the segment-features endpoint will return up to 128 features for
a segment, which at this row height is three thousand pixels of track. The
caller that fetched them chose how many to ask for; this is how it says how
many to show.

labelWidth.description:
Width reserved for row labels down the left edge. Zero hides them, which is
what the compact variant does.

loading.description: Render the skeleton instead of the data.

tracks.description:
Rows to draw, top to bottom. An ordered array rather than a set of boolean
props, which is how the design's several frames come out of one component.

viewport.description:
Visible range. Controlled when supplied — pan and zoom then report through
`onViewportChange` and change nothing until the prop comes back. Omit for
uncontrolled, where the component owns the range and starts at the
payload's full window.

onViewportChange.description: Called on pan and zoom. A shell typically re-fetches from this.

selection.type: { kind: "block"; id: string; } | { kind: "range"; end: number; start: number; } | { kind: "row"; id: string; } | { kind: "series"; id: string; }

onSelectionChange.description: (selection: GenomeSelection | null) => void. Called with the clicked block, or with null when the click clears the selection.

error.description: Render a typed error state instead of the data.

locus.description: Where in the genome the window sits. Its start and end are the bounds pan and zoom are clamped to.

sequence.description: Window nucleotides, 5' to 3'. null when the window exceeds caps.max_sequence_window or the sequence file is unavailable.

bins.description: Maps trace index to genomic coordinates. Every values array in the payload is on this axis.

annotations.description: Reference features. null, not [], means the organism has no annotation coverage at all.

segments.description: Precomputed segments. The pipeline partitions exhaustively, so they abut and leave no gaps.

features.description: Top features by score, highest first. The features row draws them in this order and never re-sorts.

pinned.description: Features the caller asked to keep regardless of score. Listed ahead of features in the accessible table.

feature_notes.description: Descriptions keyed by String(feature_id). Coverage is sparse — most features have no entry.

caps.description: What the server had to leave out, and why.

overview.description: Chromosome-scale context for a later, wider version of the minimap row. caps.overview_available distinguishes "omitted because you already have it" from "this deployment cannot draw it". Nothing reads either field today: the minimap as built takes its extent from locus.

clusters.description: Aggregate activation for clusters of co-firing features, on the same bin axis. Optional, and not drawn by any row yet.

organism_label.description: Display form of organism, for example "E. coli K-12". Shown in the header when present, with organism as the fallback.

chrom.description: Chromosome or contig name, shown in the header.

genome_length.description: Length of the genome the window is cut from.

gene.description: Gene the window is centred on, shown ahead of the organism in the header.

stride.description: Bases per point; 1 when unpooled. Each point is the maximum over its bases, so single-base peaks survive.

n_bins.description: Number of points, equal to values.length for every trace in the payload.

name.description: Gene name, falling back to the locus tag. Drawn on the block when it is wide enough, and truncated with an ellipsis when it is not.

kind.description: Feature type: CDS, tRNA, rRNA, ncRNA, mobile_element, and so on.

product.description: Gene product, shown in the tooltip and the accessible table. Reads "Not annotated" when absent.

locus_tag.description: Locus tag from the annotation source.

category.description: The category the segmentation voted for: +CDS, -CDS, intergenic, SINE, unknown, and so on. Drawn on the block beside the id.

predicted_label.description: Predicted function. null reads as "Unlabelled" rather than as a blank.

predicted_support.description: kNN vote share behind the label, 0-1.

predicted_top.description: Nearest neighbour's product, when one was resolved.

values.description: Activation across the window, on the payload's bin axis. Length equals bins.n_bins.

peak.description: Maximum raw activation in the window. Each feature row scales its bars to it.

score.description: Value of whichever metric ranked this feature.

label.description: Short display name, or "" when unknown — which is the common case, and the one the layout has to handle.

cluster.description: Cluster of co-firing features this one belongs to.

cluster_size.description: How many features the cluster holds.

max_points.description: Longest trace the server will send. A wider window is pooled to fit, which is where bins.stride comes from.

max_sequence_window.description: Widest window that comes back with a sequence. Past it the sequence row disappears.

requested_top_n.description: How many features the caller asked for.

available_features.description: Features actually firing in the window, which may exceed what was sent.

features_truncated.description: Whether features were left out. The accessible table says so when they were.

labelled_clusters.description: How many feature clusters carry a label.

overview_available.description: Whether this organism can produce a minimap at all. Distinguishes "omitted because you already have it" from "this deployment cannot draw it".

base_model.description: Model the SAE was trained against.

segmentation_threshold.description: Activation threshold the segmentation was cut at.

code.description: Server error code, which chooses the headline. The track has copy for dependency_unavailable, invalid_input, not_found, rate_limited, region_too_large, and restricted; anything else falls back to message alone.

message.description: The server's own message, shown under the headline.
